in_marathi.name: Bhaumik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaumik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is related to Bhauma, the earth god. In Hindu mythology, Bhauma is the deity who is the lord of the earth and is responsible for its protection and sustenance.
